subject: English
passage: To investigate how music tempo affects plant growth, botanical researchers exposed seedlings to different musical rhythms in controlled greenhouse conditions. The researchers, Andyy Chan and Alexa Chan, found that when plants were exposed to slow-tempo classical music, they showed reduced growth rates over a four-week period. ______ fast-tempo music was associated with accelerated growth and increased leaf development.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer. "By contrast" logically signals that the finding described in this sentence contrasts with the finding described in the previous sentence. That is, fast-tempo music was associated with accelerated growth, whereas slow-tempo music was associated with reduced growth rates.
